name: outlook-harvest
description: Read-only, byte-exact Outlook.com / Hotmail export through Microsoft Graph on the operator's own grant (delegated Mail.Read only): each message's MIME bytes to <id>.eml plus a gmh-compatible index.jsonl, so bulk mail reads never pass through a model
hits: Microsoft Graph mail (personal Outlook.com / Hotmail; bulk / byte-exact export)
surface: read-only CLI; Graph permission Mail.Read only, GET only, no write code exists; device-code sign-in (phone-friendly); `export` writes .eml files only to a directory the operator names (never `/`, `$HOME`, or the belt); index.jsonl in gmh's shape (gmf unsub-plan, gmh links and jev-test read it unchanged); 5000-message ceiling in code, `--explain` pre-flight, audit log

origin.note: authored in this belt as gmh's Microsoft twin; public client registered by the operator in Microsoft Entra (no secret)

install.description: Put omh on PATH by linking the brew bin dir at the belt's copy
install.why: exports are typed by hand and by agents from wherever the private export directory lives

env.name: OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID
env.description: The app registration's Application (client) ID; normally saved once by `omh auth --client-id` to ~/.config/toolbelt/outlook-harvest/client.json (a public client: there is no secret)

auth.flow: OAuth 2.0 device-code flow against login.microsoftonline.com/consumers with the operator's own public client: `omh auth` prints a code, the human enters it at microsoft.com/devicelogin on any device and consents to Mail.Read; access + refresh tokens are cached per account in a 600-mode file. A grant whose Graph permissions are not exactly {Mail.Read} is refused on consent, on refresh and on read
auth.login: node omh.mjs auth --client-id <GUID>   (device code; waits up to the code's lifetime)
auth.identity: node omh.mjs status   (account, scope, expiry, mode — never a token value; no network)

caches.refresh: automatic refresh-token grant; if refused, re-run `omh auth`
caches.revoke: rm ~/.config/toolbelt/outlook-harvest/<account>.json, then https://account.live.com/consent/Manage > remove the app
caches.note: dir 700, file 600, written atomically; holds access_token, refresh_token, expiry, scope, account, client_id, consented_at

caches.revoke: rm the file; delete the app registration in Microsoft Entra
caches.note: the public client id only (not a secret)

safeguards: Read-only by construction: the only Graph permission requested is Mail.Read, every Graph request is a GET, no write code exists, and a token whose Graph permissions are not exactly {Mail.Read} is refused on consent, on refresh and on read (SENSIBILITIES #1)
Ceilings are code constants in omh.mjs: MAX_MESSAGES 5000 per export or list (a higher --max is refused), DEFAULT_MAX 500, CONCURRENCY 4, TIMEOUT_MS 30000 (SENSIBILITIES #3)
`export --explain` lists and counts only: match count against the ceiling, output dir, resume state; fetches no bodies and writes nothing (SENSIBILITIES #5)
Token cache is dir 700 / file 600 outside the tree; a group/world-readable file is refused; `status` reports metadata only (SENSIBILITIES #6)

One audit line per verb run to stderr and ~/.local/share/toolbelt/outlook-harvest/audit.log (600): verb, account, selection, counts, bytes, failures, out dir — never tokens or content (SENSIBILITIES #7)
Export output is contained: `/`, $HOME itself and any path inside the Toolbelt tree are refused; the dir is created 700 and every file is written 600
File names are sha256-derived from Graph's immutable ids (safe on case-insensitive disks); per-message failures are index lines {id, error} and exit 1; export is resumable (SENSIBILITIES #8)
Politeness: 4 concurrent requests, up to 4 attempts with backoff on 429 / 5xx honoring Retry-After, stop after 10 consecutive failures (SENSIBILITIES #9)

verbs.name: auth
verbs.note: token verb: device-code sign-in for Mail.Read; writes only the operator's own 600-mode token and client files

verbs.name: status
verbs.note: token presence, mode, scope, expiry; no network

verbs.name: whoami
verbs.note: mailFolders: folder totals and unread counts

verbs.name: list
verbs.note: message ids by folder and date window or KQL search, --max up to 5000

verbs.name: export
verbs.note: messages/{id}/$value → <id>.eml (exact MIME, 600) + index.jsonl (gmh shape, plus graph_id and source_link) in a directory the operator names; --explain pre-flights

verbs.name: send / reply / forward (sendMail, createReply, …)
verbs.note: no send code and no Mail.Send permission

verbs.name: move / delete / mark read / categorize (messages PATCH/DELETE, move)
verbs.note: no modify code and no Mail.ReadWrite permission

verbs.name: rules, settings, forwarding (mailboxSettings, messageRules)
verbs.note: no settings code and no MailboxSettings permission

risk.worst_case: exports up to 5000 private messages (full MIME incl. attachments) to a local directory the operator named; nothing in the mailbox changes

checks.label: omh token cache (~/.config/toolbelt/outlook-harvest/<account>.json): mode 600, Graph scope exactly Mail.Read, refresh token present

smoke_test.expect: usage renders; unit tests and the in-memory device-code + export tests are green — no network, no credential

do_not_vendor: any export directory (private mail; containment refuses the tree)
